  <style>
    :root {

      --blue-dark: #245c6c;
      --gold: #b79a57;
      --gold-dark: #7c6a3a;
      --green: #16834a;
      --green-bg: #e7f6ed;
      --red: #b42318;
      --red-bg: #fdecea;
      --amber: #9a6700;
      --amber-bg: #fff4d6;
      --pending: #315b7d;
      --pending-bg: #eaf2f8;
      --surface: rgba(255,255,255,.94);
      --border: rgba(183,154,87,.38);
      --shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(42,75,84,.14);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      min-height: 100%;
      background: #f6f3eb;
    }

    body {
      display: flow-root;
      min-height: 100vh;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 24px 12px 55px;
      direction: rtl;
      font-family: Arial, Tahoma, sans-serif;
      color: #20363e;
      background-color: #f6f3eb;
      background-image: url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");
      background-position: center top;
      background-size: 100% auto;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-attachment: scroll;
    }

    .page {
      width: min(1180px, 100%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .panel {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 22px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      padding: 26px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
    }

    .title-card {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      padding: 22px 16px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,154,87,.36);
      border-radius: 17px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.86);
    }

    .title-card h1 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--blue);
      font-size: clamp(25px, 3.4vw, 40px);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .title-card p {
      margin: 9px 0 0;
      color: var(--gold-dark);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .login-card {
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 30px auto 10px;
      padding: 24px;
      background: rgba(250,248,241,.94);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 17px;
    }

    label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      color: var(--blue-dark);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    input, select, button {
      font: inherit;
    }

    input, select {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 48px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(47,127,150,.42);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.97);
      color: #20363e;
    }

    input:focus, select:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--blue);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,127,150,.14);
    }

    button {
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 11px;
      min-height: 46px;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .primary {
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 14px;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue), #286d7e);
    }

    .secondary {
      color: var(--blue-dark);
      background: #edf5f7;
      border: 1px solid rgba(47,127,150,.24);
    }

    .danger-ghost {
      color: #8a2d26;
      background: #fff4f2;
      border: 1px solid rgba(180,35,24,.18);
    }

    button:disabled {
      opacity: .6;
      cursor: wait;
    }

    .message {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 14px;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      text-align: center;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .message.error {
      display: block;
      color: var(--red);
      background: var(--red-bg);
    }

    .message.success {
      display: block;
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-bg);
    }

    .hidden {
      display: none !important;
    }

    .top-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .updated-at {
      color: #61747b;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(130px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .stat {
      padding: 17px 13px;
      border-radius: 15px;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    }

    .stat .number {
      display: block;
      font-size: 30px;
      font-weight: 900;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .stat .label {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .stat.total .number { color: var(--blue); }
    .stat.passed .number { color: var(--green); }
    .stat.absent .number { color: var(--red); }
    .stat.retake .number { color: var(--amber); }
    .stat.pending .number { color: var(--pending); }

    .schedule-presets {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(4), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(4),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(5), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(5),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(6), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(6),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(9), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(9),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(10), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(10),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(11), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(11),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(13), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(13),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(14), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(14),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(15), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(15),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(16), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(16),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(20), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(20),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(22), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(22),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(23), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(23),
    .schedule-mode th:nth-child(24), .schedule-mode td:nth-child(24) { display: none; }

    .filters {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(160px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: rgba(250,248,241,.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(183,154,87,.30);
    }

    .filter-wide {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }

    .table-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid rgba(47,127,150,.18);
      border-radius: 15px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
    }

    table {
      width: 100%;
      min-width: 1280px;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    th {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      padding: 13px 10px;
      color: #fff;
      background: #315f70;
      font-size: 14px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    td {
      padding: 12px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0f1;
      vertical-align: middle;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    tbody tr:hover {
      background: #f8fbfc;
    }

    .student-name {
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #244f5d;
    }

    .status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-width: 100px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .status-passed {
      color: var(--green);
      background: var(--green-bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(22,131,74,.18);
    }

    .status-absent {
      color: var(--red);
      background: var(--red-bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(180,35,24,.18);
    }

    .status-retake {
      color: var(--amber);
      background: var(--amber-bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(154,103,0,.18);
    }

    .status-pending {
      color: var(--pending);
      background: var(--pending-bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(49,91,125,.18);
    }

    .empty {
      padding: 36px 15px;
      text-align: center;
      color: #6b7d83;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .mobile-list {
      display: none;
    }

    .student-card {
      padding: 15px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.96);
      border: 1px solid rgba(47,127,150,.18);
    }

    .student-card-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .student-card-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 9px 13px;
    }

    .detail {
      color: #61747b;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .detail strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      color: #274d5a;
    }

    @media (max-width: 950px) {
      .stats {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }

      .filters {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 650px) {
      body {
        padding: 8px 8px 35px;
      }

      .panel {
        padding: 14px;
        border-radius: 16px;
      }

      .stats {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .filters {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .filter-wide {
        grid-column: auto;
      }

      .table-wrap {
        display: none;
      }

      .mobile-list {
        display: block;
      }

      .student-card-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      input, select {
        font-size: 16px;
      }
    }

    .mode-action { display:flex; justify-content:flex-start; margin:16px 0; }
    .executive-report { margin-top:18px; }
    .executive-heading { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-bottom:14px; }
    .executive-heading h2 { margin:0; color:#16394a; }
    .executive-kpis { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; }
    .executive-kpi { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e7dcc1; border-top:4px solid #c7ad70; border-radius:14px; padding:16px; }
    .executive-kpi strong { display:block; color:#2f879e; font-size:28px; margin-top:6px; }
    .executive-breakdowns { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:14px; margin-top:18px; }
    .executive-block { background:#fff; border:1px solid #e7dcc1; border-radius:14px; padding:16px; }
    .executive-block h3 { margin:0 0 12px; color:#17394a; }
    .executive-breakdown-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding:8px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #eee8da; }
    .executive-breakdown-row:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
    @media (max-width:900px) {
      .executive-kpis { grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); }
      .executive-breakdowns { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    }
    @media print {
      body { background:#fff !important; }
      .page { max-width:none; padding:0; }
      .top-actions, .filters, .schedule-presets, .mode-action, #dashboardMessage, .login-card { display:none !important; }
      .panel, .title-card, .stat, .executive-kpi, .executive-block { box-shadow:none !important; }
      #dashboardSection, #statsSection, #executiveReportSection { display:block !important; }
      .stats, .executive-kpis { grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) !important; }
      .executive-breakdowns { grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) !important; }
      @page { size:A4 landscape; margin:10mm; }
    }

  <script>
    let authToken = '';
    let searchTimer = null;
    let optionsLoaded = false;
    let refreshTimer = null;
    let summaryViewMode = 'summary';
    let summaryGroupsByVenue = {};
    let summaryAllGroups = [];
    let summaryEditOptions = { levels: [], venues: [], groupsByVenue: {}, teachers: [], teachersByGroup: {} };
    let editingStudentRow = null;
    let editSlotsById = {};
    let editSlotLoadSequence = 0;
    let currentRole = '';
    let currentRows = [];

    const SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY = 'studentExamAuthToken';
    const SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY = 'studentExamAuthSession';

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      google.script.url.getLocation(function (location) {
        configureSummaryView(location);

        const savedToken = sessionStorage.getItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY) || '';

        if (savedToken) {
          verifySavedSession(savedToken);
        } else {
          initializeSummaryFromNavigationTicket();
        }
      });
    });

    function configureSummaryView(location) {
      const requestedView = location && location.parameter
        ? String(location.parameter.view || location.parameter.page || '').toLowerCase()
        : '';

      summaryViewMode = requestedView === 'executive' || requestedView === 'schedule'
        ? requestedView
        : 'summary';

      const title = document.getElementById('pageTitle');
      const subtitle = document.getElementById('pageSubtitle');
      const stats = document.getElementById('statsSection');

      const mobileList = document.getElementById('mobileList');

      const teacherFilterWrap = document.getElementById('teacherFilterWrap');
      const achievementFilterWrap = document.getElementById('achievementFilterWrap');
      const scheduleSearchAction = document.getElementById('scheduleSearchAction');
      const executiveReportSection = document.getElementById('executiveReportSection');

      if (summaryViewMode === 'executive') {
        document.title = 'التقرير التنفيذي — نظام الاختبارات';
        title.textContent = 'التقرير التنفيذي';
        subtitle.textContent = 'تقرير تنفيذي شامل وجاهز للطباعة حسب الفلاتر المحددة';
        recordsTable.style.display = 'none';
        mobileList.style.display = 'none';
        emptyState.style.display = 'none';
        achievementFilterWrap.style.display = 'none';
        executiveReportSection.classList.remove('hidden');
        return;
      }

      if (summaryViewMode === 'schedule') {
        document.title = 'جدول الاختبارات — نظام الاختبارات';
        title.textContent = 'جدول الاختبارات';
        subtitle.textContent = 'استعراض الاختبارات حسب اليوم أو الأسبوع أو الشهر أو تاريخ مخصص';
        document.body.classList.add('schedule-mode');
        stats.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('schedulePresets').classList.remove('hidden');
        statusFilterWrap.style.display = 'none';
        teacherFilterWrap.style.display = 'none';
        achievementFilterWrap.style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('statusFilter').value = '';
        document.getElementById('teacherFilter').value = '';
        scheduleSearchAction.classList.remove('hidden');
        setScheduleRange('today', false);
        return;
      }

      document.title = 'ملخص تسجيل واختبار الطلاب — نظام الاختبارات';
    }

    function showLoginRequired(message) {
      document.getElementById('dashboardSection').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('loginSection').classList.remove('hidden');
      showMessage('loginMessage', message || 'يلزم تسجيل الدخول من بوابة النظام.', 'error');
    }

    function initializeSummaryFromNavigationTicket(fallbackMessage) {
      google.script.url.getLocation(function (location) {
        const ticket = location && location.parameter ? String(location.parameter.ticket || '') : '';
        if (!ticket) {
          showLoginRequired(fallbackMessage || 'يلزم تسجيل الدخول من بوابة النظام.');
          return;
        }
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
            if (response && response.ok && response.authenticated && response.token) {
              authToken = response.token;
              currentRole = String(response.role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
              sessionStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY, response.token);
              sessionStorage.setItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                displayName: response.displayName || response.name || response.identifier || '',
                role: response.role || ''
              }));
              openDashboard();
              return;
            }
            showLoginRequired(response && response.message ? response.message : 'تعذر فتح الصفحة. ارجع إلى بوابة النظام.');
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function () {
            showLoginRequired('تعذر فتح الصفحة. ارجع إلى بوابة النظام وحاول مرة أخرى.');
          })
          .authPortalConsumeNavigationTicket(
            ticket,
            summaryViewMode === 'executive' || summaryViewMode === 'schedule' ? summaryViewMode : 'summary'
          );
      });
    }

    function verifySavedSession(token) {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
          if (response && response.ok && response.authenticated) {
            authToken = token;
            currentRole = String(response.role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
            openDashboard();
            return;
          }

          clearSystemSession();
          initializeSummaryFromNavigationTicket(
            response && response.message
              ? response.message
              : 'انتهت الجلسة. افتح الصفحة من بوابة النظام.'
          );
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function () {
          clearSystemSession();
          initializeSummaryFromNavigationTicket(
            'تعذر التحقق من الجلسة. افتح الصفحة من بوابة النظام.'
          );
        })
        .securityVerifySupervisorSession(token);
    }

    function clearSystemSession() {
      sessionStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY);
      sessionStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY);
      try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_TOKEN_KEY); } catch (ignore) {}
      try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM_AUTH_SESSION_KEY); } catch (ignore) {}
      try { sessionStorage.removeItem('TDK_DATA_ENTRY_AUTH'); } catch (ignore) {}
      authToken = '';
      currentRole = '';
      optionsLoaded = false;
      selectedRequestIds.clear();
    }

    function openDashboard() {
      document.getElementById('loginSection').classList.add('hidden');
      document.getElementById('dashboardSection').classList.remove('hidden');
      clearMessage('loginMessage');
      optionsLoaded = false;
      const manageBar = document.getElementById('studentManageBar');
      const managementEnabled = summaryViewMode === 'summary' && currentRole === 'admin';
      manageBar.classList.toggle('hidden', !managementEnabled);
      document.body.classList.toggle('student-management-disabled', !managementEnabled);
      loadDashboard();
      startAutoRefresh();
    }

    function logout(showLoginMessage) {
      const tokenToClose = authToken;
      clearSystemSession();

      if (refreshTimer) {
        clearInterval(refreshTimer);
        refreshTimer = null;
      }

      if (tokenToClose) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(redirectAfterLogout)
          .withFailureHandler(redirectAfterLogout)
          .authStaffPortalLogout(tokenToClose);
        return;
      }
      redirectAfterLogout();
    }

    function redirectAfterLogout() {
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function (url) {
        window.top.location.replace(url + '?page=admin&logout=1');
      }).withFailureHandler(function () {
        window.top.location.href = '?page=admin&logout=1';
      }).getSystemWebAppUrl();
    }

    function goHome() {
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function (url) {
      window.top.location.href = url + '?page=home';
    })
    .withFailureHandler(function () {
      showMessage(
        'loginMessage',
        'تعذر فتح بوابة النظام. أعد فتح رابط Web App.',
        'error'
      );
    })
    .getSystemWebAppUrl();
}

function goBackSafely() {
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(function (url) {
      window.top.location.href = url + '?page=admin';
    })
    .withFailureHandler(function () {
      showMessage(
        'dashboardMessage',
        'تعذر الرجوع إلى صفحة المشرف. أعد المحاولة.',
        'error'
      );
    })
    .getSystemWebAppUrl();
}

    function startAutoRefresh() {
      if (refreshTimer) clearInterval(refreshTimer);
      refreshTimer = setInterval(loadDashboard, 60000);
    }

    function debouncedLoad() {
      if (searchTimer) clearTimeout(searchTimer);
      searchTimer = setTimeout(loadDashboard, 350);
    }

    function formatScheduleInputDate(date) {
      const year = date.getFullYear();
      const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      return year + '-' + month + '-' + day;
    }

    function setScheduleRange(period, reloadData) {
      const fromInput = document.getElementById('dateFrom');
      const toInput = document.getElementById('dateTo');
      const today = new Date();
      let fromDate = null;
      let toDate = null;

      if (period === 'today') {
        fromDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate());
        toDate = new Date(fromDate);
      } else if (period === 'week') {
        const daysSinceSaturday = (today.getDay() + 1) % 7;
        fromDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() - daysSinceSaturday);
        toDate = new Date(fromDate);
        toDate.setDate(toDate.getDate() + 6);
      } else if (period === 'month') {
        fromDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1);
        toDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() + 1, 0);
      }

      fromInput.value = fromDate ? formatScheduleInputDate(fromDate) : '';
      toInput.value = toDate ? formatScheduleInputDate(toDate) : '';
      if (reloadData && authToken) loadDashboard();
    }

    function getFilters() {
      return {
        search: valueOf('searchName'),
        identity: valueOf('identityFilter'),
        level: valueOf('levelFilter'),
        status: summaryViewMode === 'schedule' ? '' : valueOf('statusFilter'),
        venue: valueOf('venueFilter'),
        group: valueOf('groupFilter'),
        teacher: summaryViewMode === 'schedule' ? '' : valueOf('teacherFilter'),
        achievement: summaryViewMode === 'summary' ? valueOf('achievementFilter') : '',
        dateFrom: valueOf('dateFrom'),
        dateTo: valueOf('dateTo'),
        viewMode: summaryViewMode
      };
    }

    function valueOf(id) {
      const element = document.getElementById(id);
      return element ? String(element.value || '').trim() : '';
    }

    function normalizeEditDigits(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, function (digit) { return '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'.indexOf(digit); })
        .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, function (digit) { return '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'.indexOf(digit); })
        .replace(/\D/g, '');
    }

    function loadDashboard() {
      if (!authToken) return;

      showMessage('dashboardMessage', 'جاري تحديث البيانات...', 'success');

      const items = Object.keys(counts).sort(function (a, b) {
        if (field === 'level') return summaryLevelOrder(a) - summaryLevelOrder(b) || a.localeCompare(b, 'ar');
        return counts[b] - counts[a] || a.localeCompare(b, 'ar');
      });
      const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
      if (!items.length) {
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">لا توجد بيانات ضمن الفلاتر الحالية.</div>';
        return;

      container.innerHTML = items.map(function (label) {

      for (let i = 0; i < names.length; i += 1) {
        if (text.indexOf(names[i]) !== -1) return i + 1;

      const number = Number((text.match(/\d+/) || [])[0]);
      return Number.isFinite(number) && number > 0 ? number : 999;

    function toggleStudentSelection(requestId, checked) {
      if (!requestId) return;

    function clearEditSlots(message) {
      editSlotLoadSequence += 1;

      document.getElementById('editSlotLabel').value = '';

    function loadEditSlots(currentId, currentLabel, currentDate) {
      const venue = valueOf('editVenue');
      const group = valueOf('editGroup');
      if (!venue || !group) { clearEditSlots('اختر المركز والحلقة أولًا'); return; }
      const sequence = ++editSlotLoadSequence;
      const select = document.getElementById('editSlotId');
      select.innerHTML = currentId
        ? '<option value="' + escapeHtml(currentId) + '">' + escapeHtml((currentLabel || 'الموعد الحالي') + ' — الموعد الحالي') + '</option>'
        : '<option value="">جاري تحميل المواعيد…</option>';
      select.value = currentId || '';
      editSlotsById = {};
      if (currentId) editSlotsById[currentId] = { id: currentId, publicLabel: currentLabel, date: currentDate, label: currentLabel };
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(function (slots) {
        if (sequence !== editSlotLoadSequence || venue !== valueOf('editVenue') || group !== valueOf('editGroup')) return;
        const merged = [];
        if (currentId) merged.push(editSlotsById[currentId]);
        (slots || []).forEach(function (slot) { if (!editSlotsById[slot.id]) merged.push(slot); editSlotsById[slot.id] = slot; });
        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">اختر الموعد</option>' + merged.map(function (slot) {
          const suffix = slot.id === currentId ? ' — الموعد الحالي' : '';
          return '<option value="' + escapeHtml(slot.id) + '">' + escapeHtml((slot.label || slot.publicLabel || '') + suffix) + '</option>';
        }).join('');
        select.value = currentId || '';
      }).withFailureHandler(function (error) {
        if (sequence !== editSlotLoadSequence) return;
        showMessage('dashboardMessage', (error && error.message) || 'تعذر تحميل المواعيد المتاحة.', 'error');
      }).getAvailableSlotsForVenue(venue, group);

      document.getElementById('editExamDate').value = slot ? (slot.date || '') : '';

      element.textContent = '';

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&')
        .replace(/</g, '<')
        .replace(/>/g, '>')
        .replace(/"/g, '"')
        .replace(/'/g, ''');
